d:
The amalgamation of Hindi and English in this song is incredible! Lyrics penned down by Javed Akhtar in both languages touch the heart because of the incredible vocals given by Vasundhara Das, Udit Narayan and AlkaYagnik. Watch Aamir Khan, Gracy Singh and Rachael Shelly each spell out their interpretation of love.
Song Name - O Rey Chhori
Movie - Lagaan
Singer - Udit Narayan, Alka Yagnik & Vasundhara Das
Composer - A.R. Rahman
Lyricist - Javed Akhtar
Music Label - Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
2001 Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
